TOPIC 8.4 
Finding the Area Between 
Curves Expressed 
as Functions of x

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-5.A
Calculate areas in the plane 
using the definite integral.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-5.A.1
Areas of regions in the plane can be calculated 
with definite integrals.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-5
Definite integrals allow us to solve problems involving the accumulation of change in 
area or volume over an interval.
